desk.purpose: Editor background under the canvas sheet.

desk-deep.purpose: Gallery background and its 64px header. CSS var --desk-2.

chrome.purpose: rgba(26, 25, 24, 0.64) under blur(32px) saturate(180%): top bar, sidebar, bottom bars, timeline, gallery header.

chrome-solid.purpose: Colour-well ring, icon on a checked visibility box, and the opaque substitute for every glass surface under prefers-reduced-transparency or prefers-contrast: more.

sheet.purpose: rgba(32, 31, 30, 0.80) under the glass backdrop: popovers, dialogs, adjustment and pattern panels, bubbles, toasts.

sheet-raised.purpose: 6% white raised area inside sheets. CSS var --sheet-2.

sheet-control.purpose: 8% white fill for small controls: blend chips, thumbnail backing. CSS var --sheet-3.

track.purpose: 7% white: segmented track, fields, the status chip. Shipped as a literal in styles.css with no light-theme counterpart on the status chip; treat --sheet-3 as its themed source.

fill-raised.purpose: 9% white: resting buttons, menu-row and ghost hover. Tool and icon hovers ship a near-identical 10%.

fill-strong.purpose: 15% white button hover; the selected segment ships 16% and the selected brush category 12%.

line.purpose: Dividers, quiet borders, the brush-category column rule.

line-strong.purpose: The 0.5px border of every floating surface, slider tracks, separators, thumbnail rings. CSS var --line-2.

ink-secondary.purpose: Resting icons, secondary text. CSS var --ink-2; raised to 0.9 under prefers-contrast: more.

ink-tertiary.purpose: Labels, meta, units, ticks. CSS var --ink-3; raised to 0.75 under prefers-contrast: more.

chalk.purpose: The only accent: active, selected, primary, and the dashed fashion guides.

chalk-soft.purpose: 16% chalk behind an active top-bar or bottom-bar tool, with a 40-42% chalk inset ring.

chalk-tint.purpose: 10-12% chalk behind a selected layer (12%) or brush (10%), with a 38% chalk inset ring.

blue.purpose: Keyboard focus only: a 3.5px halo at 55% (45% on fields). CSS var --blue; it superseded --focus (#8fc1ff), which is still declared but never wins.

headline.purpose: Sheet titles at 18px/680; dialogs step to 21px/-0.024em, the gallery empty state to 30px.

body.purpose: Default UI text and menu rows; -0.005em body-wide.

control.purpose: Buttons at 590/14px; segments 580/13px, bottom bars 570/13px, status chip 550/12.5px, toasts 560.

label.purpose: Sentence-case field, section and table labels in Ink 60.

numeric.purpose: Slider values, dimensions, percentages, measurements; always tabular.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Popovers, dialogs, panels, floating windows, toasts. Light theme: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.08). CSS var --shadow.

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.purpose: The top highlight every glass surface carries; the sidebar uses 0.12.

shadows.name: bar-ambient-top
shadows.purpose: Top bar, which has no border at all.

shadows.name: paper-cast
shadows.purpose: Gallery artwork; hover deepens to 0 22px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.48), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3).

shadows.name: chalk-ring-active
shadows.purpose: Active top-bar tool (40%) and bottom-bar button (42%) over the Chalk Wash.

shadows.name: chalk-ring-row
shadows.purpose: Selected layer or brush row over the Chalk Tint.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus, 8px radius, no outline; fields use 45%.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: House curve: sheet and bar entrances, dialogs, toasts, switch knob, slider thumbs, artwork hover.

motion.name: material-in
motion.value: 0.3s ease-sheet; opacity 0, translateY(-10px) scale(0.965) blur(4px) to rest

motion.name: rise-sheet
motion.value: 0.34s ease-sheet; opacity 0, translate(-50%, 16px) scale(0.98) to rest
motion.purpose: Bottom bars, adjustment and pattern panels.

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform 0.12s ease-out; scale 0.965 buttons/segments, 0.9 icon tools, 0.995 rows
motion.purpose: Pointer-down feedback on every tappable element.

motion.name: hover
motion.value: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease

motion.name: chrome-hide
motion.purpose: Hiding/showing the top bar and sidebar.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: entrances collapse to fade 0.18s; artwork hover transform removed

accessibility.name: prefers-reduced-transparency
accessibility.value: backdrop-filter removed; every glass surface falls back to --chrome-solid

accessibility.name: prefers-contrast: more
accessibility.value: --line 0.24, --line-2 0.4, --ink-2 0.9, --ink-3 0.75; bars, sheets and dialogs go opaque

narrative.overview:
Atelier is a working surface, not a showcase. The artwork sits on a neutral mid-grey desk as a paper sheet with a soft cast shadow; everything else is chrome pinned to the edges where a Procreate hand already reaches: a 48px top bar with navigation and fashion tools on the left and painting tools on the right, a floating pill sidebar for size and opacity, sheets that drop from the bar with a pointer notch. The interface recedes during long sessions and can be hidden entirely.

The chrome is now real glass rather than tinted panel. Every floating surface is 64-86% opaque over a blur(32px) saturate(180%) backdrop, bounded by a 0.5px hairline and lit by an inset 0.5px top highlight, so the artwork keeps moving underneath it. Surfaces materialize instead of fading: sheets arrive from -10px at 96.5% scale with a 4px blur that resolves, on a single spring-like curve (cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), and every control answers a pointer-down with an instant scale-down (0.965 for buttons, 0.9 for bare icon tools). Radii grew with the material: 10px controls, 18px sheets and bars, 22px dialogs, a 24px sidebar rail.

The one colour the chrome owns is still tailor's-chalk yellow, and it is still a marker rather than a paint: the wash-plus-ring behind an active tool, the tint behind the selected layer or brush, the primary action, a switch turned on, the text caret, the transform rotate handle, and the dashed guides of the fashion module. Keyboard focus is the one deliberate second hue: a 3.5px system-blue halo, never confused with chalk. Text hierarchy comes from weight and ink opacity, not from hue.

The fashion module is a peer of the painting tools, not a mode: one top-bar entry ("Moda") opens a three-part menu (design the garment / prints / present the collection) that ships technical flats as clipped layer groups, a pattern-fill panel, colorway swapping and a tech-pack dialog. It reuses the same sheets, sliders and buttons; it adds no chrome of its own.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas first: chrome is translucent glass (64% opaque, 32px blur, 180% saturation) over a neutral grey desk.
One accent, chalk yellow, for state and the single primary action; one blue, for keyboard focus only.
System UI face throughout; weight (400-680) and ink opacity carry hierarchy; tabular numerals for all values.
Soft, large geometry: 10px controls, 18px sheets, 22px dialogs, 24px sidebar rail, 0.5px hairlines.
Spring motion on one curve, plus a press-scale on every tappable thing.
Measuring-tape sliders with 10% ticks, vertical in the sidebar, horizontal in sheets.
A fashion module that borrows the whole kit: flats, print areas, patterns, colorways, tech packs.

rules.name: The Chalk Mark Rule
rules.body: Chalk yellow marks what is active, selected or primary, and nothing else. At most one chalk-filled button per surface; every other chalk use is a line, a ring, a dashed guide or a 10-16% wash.

rules.name: The Ink Tiers Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy is three opacities of one ink (100 / 72 / 60), never a second text hue.

rules.name: The Themed Fill Rule
rules.body: A surface fill is a token, not a literal: read --track, --sheet-2, --sheet-3, --line so the light theme follows. A raw rgba(255,255,255,…) fill is a bug waiting for the light theme, not a style.

rules.name: The Theme-Blind Overlay Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn on the artwork itself (marching ants, brush cursor, lasso, crop, transform box and handles, clone target, eyedropper loupe) is a white stroke paired with a dark stroke or dark ring, regardless of UI theme, so it reads over any pixel.

rules.name: The Chalk Guide Rule
rules.body: The exception to the rule above: fashion guides that describe the garment rather than the edit (print area, repeat-module boundary) are dashed chalk at 80-85% opacity, 1.5px and dash lengths divided by the zoom so they stay hairline at any scale.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number the user reads or scrubs (size, opacity, percent, px dimensions, centimetres, tolerances) uses tabular numerals so values don't jitter while dragging.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at normal tracking; the chrome carries no uppercase, letter-spaced tags, no kickers and no eyebrow lines above titles.

rules.name: The Real Weight Rule
rules.body: Weights are variable-axis values (550-680) with synthesis off; never fake a weight the face doesn't have.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Big shadows belong to surfaces that float over the canvas; bar-attached chrome gets glass, a hairline and an inset highlight instead.

rules.name: The Real Glass Rule
rules.body: Every translucent chrome or sheet surface carries backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(180%); translucency without blur is not allowed, and glass without an accessible fallback is not shipped: under prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce or prefers-contrast: more the same surfaces fall back to opaque Solid Graphite.

rules.name: The One Curve Rule
rules.body: Sheets, bars, dialogs, toasts, switch knobs, slider thumbs and artwork hovers all move on cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) at 0.16-0.4s; entrances also resolve a 4px blur. Reduced motion collapses every entrance to an 0.18s fade.

dos: **Do** keep chrome at the edges: top bar (48px), sidebar rail, sheets dropping from the bar, contextual bars floating 14px above the bottom.
**Do** give every translucent surface `blur(32px) saturate(180%)`, a 0.5px hairline and an inset 0.5px top highlight, and keep the opaque fallbacks for reduced transparency and increased contrast.
**Do** reserve chalk for active, selected and primary states: the 16% wash plus a 40% ring for active tools, the 10-12% tint plus a 38% ring for selected rows, one chalk button per surface.
**Do** give every tappable element a press response: 0.965 for buttons and segments, 0.9 for bare icon tools, 0.995 for rows.
**Do** animate on the single house curve `cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` and honour reduced motion.
**Do** tick every continuous slider at 10% intervals and set its value in tabular numerals.
**Do** draw edit overlays as a white stroke paired with a dark stroke or ring, independent of the UI theme; reserve dashed chalk for fashion guides, scaled by zoom.
**Do** read every colour and fill from the custom properties so the light theme follows automatically.
**Do** keep the keyboard focus halo blue (`3.5px`, 55%), distinct from chalk.
**Do** build new fashion surfaces out of the existing kit: menu rows, sheets, segmented controls, horizontal sliders, switches, one primary button.
donts: **Don't** introduce docked panel stacks, a menu bar or a tool palette; tools belong in the top bar, sidebar, sheets and contextual bottom bars.
**Don't** add a second accent hue, or use chalk as decoration, background or large fill beyond the single primary button.
**Don't** use hard or offset shadows; depth is soft, diffuse and paired with glass.
**Don't** add uppercase, letter-spaced labels, kickers or eyebrow lines to the chrome.
**Don't** make a glass surface opaque over the canvas except through the accessibility fallbacks; the artwork should stay visible behind bars and sheets.
**Don't** hard-code a white or black alpha fill where a token exists; unthemed literals break the light theme.
**Don't** shape an action like a pill: pills are for readouts (the status chip) and the sidebar rail.
**Don't** use Procreate's name, icons, brush files or other assets, or any real brand's garment artwork; the interaction model is shared, the identity is Atelier's.
